name: certified_exchange_wedge_liability
rule: 2 + conflict_weight/max(1e-9,weight+conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight or (2*neighbor_pairs == degree*(degree-1) and weight >= max_conflict_weight) else weight/max(1e-9,weight+max(max_conflict_weight,conflict_weight-2*neighbor_min_mass/max(1,degree))) + 0.01/(1+degree)
rationale: Replace global completion estimates with local exchange certificates and a competition ratio. Give first priority to vertices whose weight dominates their entire neighborhood, or whose neighborhood is a clique with no heavier competitor. Otherwise discount blocked weight by mutual conflicts among neighbors, retain the strongest competitor as a penalty floor, and mildly favor smaller degree. The two local structural features avoid residual packing and covering computations.
